title: Check Point reports new Iran-nexus group Volant Manticore phishing Cyprus airline and Saudi healthcare targets
date_note: The report's publication day; the pages give campaign dates (from July 2026) but no single event day.
geo_basis: Cyprus is the country Check Point lists as the group's main target; no city stated
actor: Volant Manticore (as named by Check Point)

attribution.note: Check Point has high confidence the group is Iran-nexus and medium confidence it is historically linked to Iran's Ministry of Intelligence and Security.

summary: Check Point Research describes Volant Manticore, a previously undocumented Iran-nexus group it says dates back to September 2025. It says the group sent a fake CV delivering the KuboShell backdoor to a Cyprus-based airline, and from September 2026 sent healthcare-themed phishing lures to Saudi Arabian organisations. Check Point has high confidence in the Iran link and medium confidence the group is a separate cluster of former MuddyWater operators.
plain: Check Point says a new Iran-linked hacking group has been phishing a Cyprus-based airline and, since September 2026, Saudi healthcare organisations.
exec: Check Point attributes phishing against airline and healthcare targets to a newly identified Iran-nexus group.
impact: Check Point's report describes targeting; the pages read do not state a confirmed breach or data theft.

validation.note: Check Point Research's own report was read; the Jerusalem Post relays the same research.

review.note: attribution block was missing actor, origin_country and coordinates (build errors); added Iran/Tehran per Check Point's Iran-nexus attribution
